title: On Nonsmooth and Relatively Weakly Convex Minimization
summary: Composite optimization plays a central role in modern machine learning and signal processing, as it offers a natural balance between data fidelity and structural properties. In this paper, we study composite optimization in the setting where both components are nonsmooth and nonconvex. We start with a deterministic Bregman proximal subgradient method that converges under subgradient upper-bound conditions.
